The '''First Republic Medical Academy of Coruscant''' was the primary medical school within the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> a premier educational institution on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]] attended the Academy<ref name="Holonet" /> to study [[xenopathology]], though some students claimed that Kimble received favorable treatment from female instructors.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Unidentified Republic doctor|One]] of Kimble's fellow students later went on to become the head of the [[Republic Health Administration]] despite his poor performance in medical school.<ref name="Opportunity Knocks">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|Opportunity Knocks}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Academy was first mentioned in [[The Holonet]], a division of the official site for the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', within the entry for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Doc&mdash;the entry which revealed Doc's real name to be Archiban Kimble.<ref name="Holonet" /> The reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', released in [[2012]] further specified that Kimble's medical school had been a division of the University of Coruscant.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
